title: Multivitamin Dosage Regimens in the Prevention of Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes Among HIV-Positive Women
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine effects of daily administration of multivitamin supplements at doses resembling the Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) during pregnancy to HIV positive women decreases the risks of low birth weight (\<2500 g), and pre-term birth (\< 37 weeks gestation), compared to multivitamin supplements at doses above the RDA.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- HIV-positive pregnant women who are between 12 and 27 weeks gestation who intend to stay in Dar es Salaam until delivery.
